manualSteps: Required: choose iCloud or Obsidian Sync, not both for the same vault, and prove a temporary-note round trip between laptop and iPhone (SETUP.md steps 1-2)
Required: enable Daily notes, Templates, Search, and Word count in Obsidian
Required: install QuickAdd from Community plugins and enable it; QuickAdd is not bundled
Required: restart Obsidian and confirm Journal Flow Click Guard under Installed plugins and in the desktop runtime registry (SETUP.md step 4)
Required: configure and enable the New Check-in and New Analyze Thought Macro choices as commands in QuickAdd UI; do not rewrite data.json
Required: finish iPhone sync and plugin setup, restart the app, and confirm both commands are available (SETUP.md step 5)
Required: perform the desktop and iPhone acceptance checklist and confirm journal entries and Daily Note links sync both ways; CLI verification does not prove iOS UAT (SETUP.md step 6)
Optional: assign conflict-free desktop hotkeys and iOS mobile-toolbar commands
Optional: reload and enable the journal-flow CSS snippet on each device
